'''Sambe''' is a presumably extinct [[Plateau language]] of [[Nigeria]] once spoken in the village of the same name. The Sambe people have shifted to [[Ninzo language|Ninzo]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogmios.org/ogmios_files/206.htm|title=Foundation for Endangered Languages|date=2001|author=Blench, Roger|publisher=ogmios|access-date=December 26, 2021}}</ref>

Sambe is unusual in contrasting {{IPA|/k͡p/}} and {{IPA|/k͡pʷ/}}, a [[Labial–velar consonant|rare distinction]] in the world’s languages. For example, 
:{{IPA|/k͡pùk͡pʷɛ̀/}} "cough"
:{{IPA|/kə́k͡pɛ/}} "choose"<ref name=Blench/>
